subject: Mutual action plan & POC ops ownership for GreenGrid trial

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Chen <amelia.chen@greengrid.ai>, Markus Vogel <markus.v@greengrid.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 16:12:33 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan & POC ops ownership for GreenGrid trial

Hi Amelia / Markus — thanks again for the call earlier today. Short recap + proposed MAP and ownership so we can start scheduling work this week.

High-level objective:
- 2-week trial to validate inference latency at 99th percentile < 120ms for core query set and accuracy within 3% of your current baseline on the 10k sample set.

Success criteria (what GreenGrid will sign off on):
- Latency: 99p <= 120ms for steady-state traffic profile (50 RPS).
- Quality: generation/response metrics within 3% of baseline on provided eval suite (eval set v2026-09-10).
- Cost projection: projected per-1M-token cost with Redwood Dedicated profile (estimate attached).
- Integration: test app sends real payloads, KV caching exercised, and end-to-end smoke tests pass.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Week 0 (this week): map owners, confirm infra access and procurement steps.
- Week 1: infra provisioning + test dataset ingestion (smoke by EOD Friday).
- Week 2: run load/latency experiments, iterate on batching/config, finalize handoff.

Who owns what (proposal):
- Redwood infra & deployment (GPU pools, autoscaling): Karthik Iyer
- App integration & test harness (SDK calls, payloads): Karthik Iyer
- Security/compliance evidence & SOC2 checklist: Kimberly Park
- Procurement/contract & PO coordination: Kimberly Park

Next steps for GreenGrid: please confirm the success criteria above and whether the sample eval set (we received v2026-09-10) is final. Also, can you confirm which environments we should target (us-east-1 vs eu-west-1)?

Attachments: GG_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + acceptance checklist)

I'll loop our infra and security leads on the follow-up so we can lock dates. Want to avoid scope surprises for your SREs.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 415-555-0142

- SOC2: our security team will need a short evidence package (access control, audit logs, data flow diagram). I've attached a short request doc that lists what they'd like (SOC2_evidence_request.pdf).

Can Kimberly own the SOC2 exchange and procurement milestones? We'll need a purchase order for trial infrastructure if possible — procurement lead is myself (Amelia).
